about: Production harness: the controls wrapped around an architecture so it can run safely in production. Which controls apply depends on the architecture and the goal. Controls that call a model are priced from this run's measured results; the rest add no model cost.

assumptions.live_eval_note: Share of live traffic graded by a judge call. 2% is a starting point, not a standard; raise it for high-impact agents.

input_guard.name: Input guardrail
input_guard.what: Screens each request for prompt injection, jailbreaks and off-topic use before it can steer the agent.

output_check.name: Output validation and retry
output_check.what: Checks each answer against the expected format or allowed labels and retries once if it fails.

grounding.name: Grounding check
grounding.what: Confirms each answer is supported by the retrieved documents; unsupported answers are withheld.

tool_gate.name: Tool permissions and approval
tool_gate.what: Allow-list of tools, least-privilege credentials, and a person approves irreversible actions.

limits.name: Step, time and spend limits
limits.what: Caps model turns, tokens and spend per request; stops and hands off to a person when hit.

calibration.name: Escalation monitor
calibration.what: Tracks how often the small model escalates and how accurate its confident answers are; alerts on drift.

failover.name: Timeouts, retries and failover
failover.what: Times out slow calls, retries with backoff and switches to the fallback model on errors or outages.

tracing.name: Tracing and cost metering
tracing.what: Logs every step with model, tokens, cost and latency so failures can be replayed and spend charged back.

regression.name: Regression test suite
regression.what: This run's test cases become a release gate, re-run before every prompt or model change.

live_eval.name: Live quality sampling
live_eval.what: A judge call grades a sample of live answers; alerts when accuracy drops.
